janaka.cp: masc. a producer; father. (adj.), producing; generating.
janaka.p: [Jana+ṇvu] (pu) CL=8 Jana+aka. Janayatīti janako, ṇvu. Dhāna,ṭī.243. Jana janane, janetīti janako. Rū.571. Janetīti janako. Pitā. Ṇvādi.18.janayatīti janako. Pitā, yo koci vā nibbattetā. Nīti,dhā.233.In thī janikā]  (1) Father. Father. (2) King Zanaka. (A)Future Buddha named Janaka who is master Mithilā Country. (B) King Janaka who is master of Bārāṇasī Country. (Na) (3) Janaka Kamma, Kamma which is to be pregnancy, effect of Pavatti, (Ti)  (4) it is to be happened (cause etc.,) . (5) (region/place) where born. Janakakapilavatthusannissaya- see.
pn: Janaka 01. King of Mithilā, a previous birth of the Bodhisatta. For his story, see the Mahā Janakajātaka (Ja 539). Ja.i.268; Ja.vi.59.
Janaka 02. King of Benares. His minister was Senaka, whose story is related in the Sattubhastajātaka (Ja 402). Ja.iii.341, 348.
a: ဇန+အက။ ဇနယတီတိ ဇနကော၊ ဏွု။ ဓာန်၊ဋီ။၂၎၃။ ဇန ဇနနေ၊ ဇနေတီတိ ဇနကော။ ရူ။၅၇၁။ ဇနေတီတိ ဇနကော။ ပိတာ။ ဏွာဒိ။၁၈။ဇနယတီတိ ဇနကော။ ပိတာ, ယော ကောစိ ဝါ နိဗ္ဗတ္တေတာ။ နီတိ၊ဓာ။၂၃၃။ထီ၌ ဇနိကာ] (၁)အဖ၊ ဖခင်။(၂)ဇနကမင်း။(က)မိထိလာပြည့်ရှင့် ဘုရားလောင်း ဇနကမင်း။(ခ)ဗာရာဏသီပြည့်ရှင် ဇနကမင်း။(န)(၃)ဇနကကံ၊ ပဋိသန္ဓေ, ပဝတ္တိကျိုးကို ဖြစ်စေတတ်သော ကံ။(တိ)(၎)ဖြစ်စေတတ်သော(အကြောင်းစသည်)။(၅)ဖြစ်ရာ-မွေးဖွားရာ-ဖြစ်သော(အရပ်)။ ဇနကကပိလဝတ္ထုသန္နိဿယ-ကြည့်။

( and janika, mfn. ) [ cf S. janaka], begetting; generating, producing; (one) who gives or has given birth (to); (m.) a progenitor, a father; a parent; (f.) a mother ; Abh 243 (tāto tu ~o pitā); 244 (janettī janikā); Vin IV 335, 4 (mātāpitaro nāma ~ā vuccanti); Ja II 261, 4´ (tena bhūtapacaniṃ pacī ti vuccati, pajanin ti pi pāṭho, janikaṃ nibbattakin ti attho, Be, Ce so; Se janitaṃ nibbattitan ti attho; Ee jātikiṃ nibbattikin ti attho) = Ps I 58, 26 ( eds janikaṃ nibbattikan ti); Nidd I 8, 16 (yo rāgo … māyā janikā sañjananī) = Dhs 1059 = Vibh 361, 23 ; Nidd II 207, 23 (pitā ti yo so ~o); Ap 429, 23 (imassa janikā mātā Māyā nāma bhavissati); Bv 2:206 (Sumedhā nāma janikā Dīpaṅkarassa satthuno); Mil 218, 22 (puttaṃ yoniyā janayitvā mātā janikā ti vuccati); Vism 601, 26 foll. (catubbidhaṃ kammaṃ ~aṃ upatthambhakaṃ upapīḷakaṃ upaghātakan ti); Ps I 300, 29 (tass’ eva kho pana dukkhassa janikaṃ samuṭṭhāpikaṃ purimataṇhaṃ); III 412, 1 (janikā mātā ti yāya tumhe janitā sā vo janikā mātā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee janīmātā ti yā sā tumhe janikā sā vo janikā mātā, prob. wr ); 412, 4 (yo janiko pitā); V 12, 26 (paṭisandhi-nibbattakaṃ pana kammaṃ °-kammaṃ nāma, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr °-dammam); Spk II 29, 17 (tass’ attabhāvassa ~ānaṃ avijjāsaṅkhārānaṃ diṭṭhakālo); Pj II 160, 14 (maggadhammassa °-ttā); Th-a II 259, 34 (kalyāṇa-dhammānaṃ mātubhūtaṃ ~an ti attho); Mhv 63:17; Sadd 865, 19 (janetī ti ~o); — ifc see paṭibhāna-; — ajanaka , mf (-ikā) n. , not generating, not producing; who does not give or has not given birth (to) ; Sp 1023, 4 (manussitthībhūtā pi ajanikā posāvanikā mātā); Sv 105, 6 (vañjho ti … aphalo kassaci ~o ti); Ps I 192, 32 (ye keci akusalā dhammā paṭisandhijanakā vā ~ā vā); Vibh-a 154, 14 (~-ttā).
